Since the right angle in \(\triangle ABC\) is at \(B\):

\[
AC=\sqrt{AB^2+BC^2}=\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=\sqrt{169}=13.
\]

Then in \(\triangle ACD\), right angle at \(C\):

\[
AD=\sqrt{AC^2+CD^2}=\sqrt{13^2+8^2}=\sqrt{233}.
\]

In \(\triangle ADE\), right angle at \(D\):

\[
AE=\sqrt{AD^2+DE^2}=\sqrt{233+12^2}=\sqrt{377}.
\]

In \(\triangle AEF\), right angle at \(E\):

\[
AF=\sqrt{AE^2+EF^2}=\sqrt{377+8^2}=\sqrt{441}=21.
\]

\[
\boxed{21}
\]
